arabic_html:
وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ٱدْعُونِىٓ أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ ۚ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِى
سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ ۞
translit: Wa qāla rabbukumu-dʿūnī astajib lakum. Inna-lladhīna yastakbirūna ʿan ʿibādatī sayadkhulūna jahannama dākhirīn.
hook:
Allah is waiting
for you to ask.
translation: And your Lord says, 'Call upon Me; I will respond to you.' Indeed, those who disdain My worship will enter Hell contemptible.
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr: Allah encourages His servants to call on Him — and guarantees to respond. And as the Prophet ﷺ said, the supplication is itself worship. To ask is not a burden to Him; it is what He invites.
explanation_vo: As Ibn Kathir explains, Allah encourages His servants to call on Him, and guarantees to respond. And as the Prophet, peace be upon him, said: the supplication is itself worship. To ask is not a burden to Him. It is what He invites.
